decisions.reason: The client approves compatible LED lighting but does not change the decorative controls; the proposed power-button replacement remains explicitly unresolved.
The prototype BOM must now account for suitable LED components compatible with the existing electrical setup.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Okay, and apologies for replying late. Yes to the LED lights; please choose suitable ones that are compatible with your setup. I’m unclear about what you meant when you said, " I could add button to the list similar to that one instead of the on off switch that it is now." What I want to prevent is having another base constructed before we are creatively aligned. The base is going to be the most visible component. The goal is to add extra details that give the machine some flash and pizazz. I simply want it to be fun and visually appealing for social media.

value_updates.led_component_selection: suitable LEDs compatible with the existing setup

decisions.reason: The LED decision does not change the established beige and green color scheme.
Lighting technology and visual appeal do not alter the required mixing or frothing behavior.
The source approves bowl lighting but does not change the measurement-style markings around the bowls.
The request for creative alignment on the visible base does not establish any change to its logo, font, lettering, or leaf treatment.
The source does not change the machine placard text, placement, or viewing orientations.
The client expresses uncertainty about a proposed power-button replacement but does not change the K markings on the dispense buttons.
Adding compatible LED accent lighting does not alter bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
The lighting decision has no necessary effect on spout geometry, orientation, material, or dispensing access.
The source changes visual lighting details without altering splash-control targets or mitigation methods.
LED compatibility with the setup does not change requirements for materials that contact food or liquid.
